verdicts.reason: A crams the image strip, '&' mark and 'Baby Toddler BEDDING' lockup into the top quarter. That leaves roughly 75% of the tall canvas as dead navy, and the dot grids float at mid-height with the right-hand grid clipped at the edge. B at least centres the lockup vertically and moves the dots to the bottom, which gives a more deliberate balance. Both still shrink the wordmark to a small size with vast empty space around it. The blue image becomes a thin sliver jammed at the top with dots over it, and the layout looks like a shrunk banner rather than a redesigned tall format.
